verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms IAM's core purpose ("who can do what on which resource") and mentions Workload Identity Federation for identity-based access, but there is no documentation in the pack about IAM Conditions (attribute-based conditional bindings), resource-level scoping mechanics, or how policy evaluation order/inheritance works across the resource hierarchy. Missing for 10: IAM Conditions syntax/examples, resource-level policy scoping details, documented policy evaluation/inheritance logic, and any independent corroboration of these features working as described.
